universe_note:
Chain-level campaign-v1 screen (identity_schema campaign-v1, scenario_id null), first run for this chain. The mapping (data/mappings/humanoid-actuators.json, 7 issuers, 8 placements) was created roughly two hours before this run, is status ACTIVE, and has no whole-census audit at all (audit block absent, never run), so every row on this chain must clear Ron's 2026-09-01 PLACEMENT-scope rule: declare audit_scope 'PLACEMENT' and rest on a placement whose evidence is entirely VERIFIED, or on a current PASS placement_audits[] entry for that exact issuer, link and chain. Atlas time-boxed its first universe pass to 5 of the chain's 13 links, worked in priority order: the one money-corner link (precision-machine-tools) first, then the UNDISCOVERED link dexterous-hands, then the three EMERGING links roller-screws, torque-motors and sensors-encoders. This run works exactly those 5 links, in that order, because a campaign-era screen may consume only what the mapping has already censused (method 6A: a newly discovered issuer returns through run universe before it counts) -- it does not run its own EDGAR discovery to add names.

THE FINDING THIS RUN PRODUCES: zero of the 8 placements across those 5 links seat a row, but for two different reasons that matter to distinguish, and this chain is now mid-flight on the profile stage as a parallel batch works it: as this screen was being written, other sessions in the same batch landed BLOCKED/O3 profiles for 4 of the 7 mapping issuers (MOOG, CURTISS-WRIGHT, TIMKEN, KLINGELNBERG), each still short its canonical fundamentals with prices/fundamentals/quality/pcs/insider/edgar_doc requests already queued and, for CURTISS-WRIGHT, its price/fundamentals/quality/pcs/insider/edgar_doc requests already FULFILLED on disk as of this run (REQ-20260906-133 through 138) though the profile itself has not yet been re-run to pick that data up. ALLIENT, REGAL-REXNORD and NOVANTA still have no profile file at all. None of the 7 changes this run's row count: a BLOCKED/O3 profile is refused by campaign identity exactly like a missing one (both fail the COMPLETE-O1-or-O2 requirement), so every placement-admissible name stays unseated regardless -- but the fix for 4 of them is now 'let the queued fetch land, then re-run the profile', not 'run the profile for the first time'.

Five placements (MOOG and CURTISS-WRIGHT and TIMKEN on roller-screws; ALLIENT on torque-motors and again on sensors-encoders) are mechanically ADMISSIBLE at placement level right now. Three placements (KLINGELNBERG on precision-machine-tools; REGAL-REXNORD and NOVANTA on torque-motors and sensors-encoders respectively) are additionally INADMISSIBLE at placement level itself, independent of the profile question.

precision-machine-tools [MONEY CORNER, CHOKE_POINT, verdict UNDISCOVERED]: searched and empty. Its sole placement, KLINGELNBERG (SIX-KLIN, SIX Swiss Exchange, T3), carries one evidence item tagged INFERRED, so it fails the all-VERIFIED-evidence basis outright. The mapping's own placement_audits[] records a fresh-context PASS/FAIL review of exactly this placement, audited_at 2026-09-06T17:51:24Z, status FAIL: role_ok is false because a live re-fetch of the cited URL (klingelnberg.com/en/business-divisions/bevel-gear-technology) does not contain the placement's quoted sentence anywhere on the page, even though the identical sentence verifies verbatim, character for character, on a different official Klingelnberg page (the group homepage, klingelnberg.com/en/). The audit itself characterizes this as a citation-accuracy defect (right issuer, right quote, wrong URL) rather than a role-substance defect, and names the exact fix in its own amendments_required field: correct evidence[0].url to the group homepage, or replace the excerpt with a sentence that actually appears on the currently-cited bevel-gear-technology page. Until that FAIL becomes a fresh PASS, this run's sole money-corner candidate clears neither placement-admission basis. A profile for KLINGELNBERG now exists (BLOCKED, O3, T3, sourced partly from its own FY2024/25 Annual Report per the T2/T3 official-source route, awaiting KLIN.SW market data) but a BLOCKED/O3 profile cannot seat a row regardless of the audit outcome. This is the link this whole screen exists to clear first, and it stays UNDISCOVERED after this run for two documented, correctable reasons rather than a silent absence.

dexterous-hands [not money corner, verdict UNDISCOVERED]: searched and empty, but EXHAUSTED by the mapping itself at zero placements, not blocked by identity or profile gaps. Atlas's own combined_search_scope covers two independent, differently-typed censuses: SEC EDGAR's complete full-text index of every US public filer's 10-Ks (zero hits for a dexterous-hand qualification boundary, against 14 real hits for the comparably specific control phrase 'humanoid robot', so the zero is a genuine absence rather than a broken query) and current industry trade press naming every identified dexterous-hand specialist (Shadow Robot, Wonik Inspire, Tesollo, 1X Technologies, and China's newest spinoffs) -- every one privately held or pre-IPO, with the most advanced candidate, Tesollo, itself reported as aiming to be the first dedicated dexterous-hand firm ever to list on any exchange. Nothing for this screen to seat here; the chain's own map_limitation already states listed exposure to this link runs through its actuator, sensor and machine-tool suppliers on the other links instead.

roller-screws [EMERGING, CHOKE_POINT bottleneck]: 3 placements (MOOG/MOG.A NYSE T1, CURTISS-WRIGHT/CW NYSE T1, TIMKEN/TKR NYSE T1). Every one clears placement admission via a current PASS placement_audits[] entry (all three fresh-context audited 2026-09-06 between 17:49 and 17:51Z), even though each placement's own evidence tag is INFERRED (a Moog defense-systems PDF, a Curtiss-Wright/Exlar product page, a Timken linear-motion business page -- none a filed SEC document). All 3 now have a profile in flight rather than none: MOOG (BLOCKED/O3/T1, all 12 canonical fields NULL, prices/fundamentals/quality/pcs/insider/edgar_doc PENDING under REQ-20260906-145 through 150), CURTISS-WRIGHT (BLOCKED/O3/T1, same 6 kinds now FULFILLED under REQ-20260906-133 through 138 but the profile has not yet been re-run against that data), TIMKEN (BLOCKED/O3/T1, same 6 kinds PENDING under REQ-20260906-139 through 144). This link is the closest to seating real rows of anything on this chain: CURTISS-WRIGHT in particular should complete to COMPLETE/O2 on the very next `run profile CW` now that its data is fulfilled, with no further mapping or audit work needed.

torque-motors [EMERGING]: 2 placements. ALLIENT/ALNT (Nasdaq, T1) carries a VERIFIED evidence item (its own FY2022 Form 10-K Item 1 Business text, filed under its prior name Allied Motion Technologies before its rename to Allient Inc and ticker change from AMOT to ALNT) and so clears the all-VERIFIED-evidence basis directly, with no placement audit needed; it still has no profile file on disk at all. REGAL-REXNORD/RRX (NYSE, T1) carries only an INFERRED trade-press item about its Kollmorgen brand's TBM2G motor series, and the mapping's placement_audits[] array carries no entry at all for REGAL-REXNORD on any link, so it clears neither admission basis and is inadmissible at placement level, independent of any profile question; it also has no profile. Neither seats a row.

sensors-encoders [EMERGING]: 2 placements. NOVANTA/NOVT (Nasdaq, T1) carries only an INFERRED 2021 trade-press acquisition report (its ATI Industrial Automation purchase) with no placement_audits[] entry, so it is inadmissible at placement level and also unprofiled -- genuinely empty for this run on the incremental name. ALLIENT/ALNT appears a second time here (its filed 10-K also names incremental and absolute optical encoders among its products, VERIFIED tag, same admissible basis as above); per method section 6 an issuer appearing on two links lists once, under the higher-priority link, so ALLIENT's canonical row belongs on torque-motors and its status here is identical: admissible at placement level, blocked only on the still-missing profile.

The remaining 8 links on this 13-link chain (compute-vla, battery-thermal, cycloidal-reducers, harmonic-reducers, ndfeb-magnets, actuator-modules, humanoid-oem, deployment) carry zero placements in the mapping's own link_coverage and were not part of Atlas's time-boxed first pass; they are honestly OPEN and uncensused, not 'searched and found empty' by this screen. A campaign-era screen cannot add issuers to an uncensused link itself (method 6A), so they are left out of scope for this run rather than populated by ad hoc EDGAR search.

SUMMARY: 0 of 13 links produced a seated row. 8 placements examined across the 5 researched links: 5 are admissible at placement level (MOOG, CURTISS-WRIGHT, TIMKEN via current PASS placement audits; ALLIENT x2 via VERIFIED filed evidence) and 3 are not (KLINGELNBERG via a FAILED placement audit citation defect; REGAL-REXNORD and NOVANTA via INFERRED evidence with no placement audit on record). Of the 7 issuers in this mapping, 4 now have a profile in flight (MOOG, CURTISS-WRIGHT, TIMKEN, KLINGELNBERG, all BLOCKED/O3, none yet COMPLETE) and 3 have none (ALLIENT, REGAL-REXNORD, NOVANTA). This screen is an identity/sequencing finding, not a lack-of-candidates finding: the money-corner link and every EMERGING link already have real, admissible or near-admissible names censused by Atlas, and the profile stage is actively closing the gap in parallel. Next steps, in order: (1) re-run `run profile CW` now that its fetch data is FULFILLED -- the fastest path to this chain's first COMPLETE/O2 name; (2) let the PENDING MOOG and TIMKEN requests (REQ-20260906-139 through 150) land, then re-run their profiles; (3) run profile ALNT for the still-unstarted ALLIENT, which unblocks one placement on each of two links at once; (4) Atlas corrects KLINGELNBERG's evidence[0].url (or its excerpt) per the audit's own amendments_required and re-runs `run universe-audit humanoid-actuators --placement KLINGELNBERG`, and lets its own KLIN.SW requests land so the profile can complete too; (5) Atlas records a placement audit or upgrades evidence to VERIFIED for REGAL-REXNORD and NOVANTA if they are to be admitted; (6) Atlas continues run universe on the 8 remaining OPEN links.
